pages.title: Arcanist's Garb
pages.text: Steel is for those who fight. Cloth woven with shard-thread is for those who $(l)cast$().$(br2)Each piece is lighter than iron, and each lends its own gift:$(li)$(l)Hood$(): spells cost 10% less mana$(li)$(l)Robe$(): Forbidden spells leave 25% less corruption$(li)$(l)Leggings$(): mana returns 50% faster$(li)$(l)Boots$(): channeled spells charge 25% faster

pages.title: The Full Garb
pages.text: Wear all four pieces together and the threads begin to resonate:$(li)Spell cooldowns are $(l)15% shorter$()$(li)Corruption fades $(l)three times$() as fast$(br2)The garb can be repaired with purple wool, and takes enchantments well.
